name: Dewanekhas Restaurant
must_try: Balti chicken karahi with daal and naan
pros: Consistently ranked #1 restaurant in Skardu on Tripadvisor
Authentic Balti home-style cooking (chicken, daal, mixed veg)
Long-running, reliable spot trusted by repeat travellers
cons: Can get busy and slow in peak tourist season
take: The default safe bet in town for proper Balti food - unfussy, tasty, and the most-reviewed restaurant in Skardu.

name: Shahi Dewan
must_try: Pakistani or Kashmiri thaal / BBQ platter
pros: Private dining rooms with table or floor seating
Strong, varied platters (BBQ, mutton gravy, fresh naans)
Attentive service and a genuine sit-down experience
cons: Some reviewers felt ambiance lagged behind the food quality
take: Skardu's go-to for a special, sit-down meal with a private room - food is the star, book ahead in season.

name: The Grind Cafe and Eatery
must_try: Yak burger and specialty coffee with cake
pros: Rare proper espresso-based coffee and baked cakes in Skardu
Novel yak burger you won't find easily elsewhere
Clean, cozy, comfortable with WiFi
cons: Very few reviews so far (new-ish spot)
More of a Western cafe break than a local-food experience
take: The best Western-style coffee-and-cake stop in town and a fun yak-burger novelty - ideal for a mid-day break.

name: City Inn Restaurant
pros: Known among locals as a top spot for honest Pakistani food
Quick service - food comes out fast
Good value for budget travellers
cons: Basic surroundings, not a scenic/destination venue
take: A local favourite for fast, no-nonsense desi food at fair prices - eat where the Skardu locals eat.

name: Mamtu De Skardu
must_try: Mamtu (steamed Balti meat dumplings) with sauce
pros: Widely rated the best mamtu/dumplings in Skardu
Authentic single-dish specialist done very well
Friendly owner, cheap and genuine
cons: Very limited seating and modest premises
take: If you try one local dish in Skardu, make it the mamtu here - travellers repeatedly call it the best in town.

name: Cafe De North
must_try: Pizza or pasta with a coffee
pros: Family-friendly with a varied Western-leaning menu
Reliable for a quick burger or pizza break
Decent volume of consistent reviews
cons: Not the place for authentic Balti cuisine
take: A solid family/Western option when you want pizza, pasta or coffee rather than karahi.

name: Shangrila Resort (Pagoda Restaurant)
area: Lower Kachura Lake, ~20-30 min from Skardu city
must_try: Grilled fresh trout by the heart-shaped lake
pros: Iconic lakeside setting at the heart-shaped Lower Kachura Lake
Fresh trout from the resort's own hatchery
The classic Skardu 'dining with a view' experience
cons: Service can be slow and patchy (long waits, cleanliness lapses reported)
Tourist-priced; food quality is inconsistent vs the setting
take: You come for the unbeatable lake setting and fresh trout more than flawless service - a Skardu rite of passage.

name: Food Street Api Xhoq
must_try: BBQ platter in the open-air setting
pros: Open-air, natural setting with BBQ and bonfire facilities
Wide menu spanning Balti, Pakistani, Chinese and fast food
Relaxed atmosphere good for groups
cons: Very few reviews to go on
take: A laid-back open-air BBQ spot - nice for an evening with a fire if the weather is good.

name: Mount Feast Restaurant
must_try: Breakfast buffet on the terrace (desi omelets, pancakes)
pros: Panoramic mountain views from the terrace
Well-regarded breakfast buffet
Broad menu (desi karahi/biryani, Chinese, fast food)
cons: No verified standalone restaurant rating found (only hotel booking scores)
Hotel-restaurant feel rather than a destination eatery
take: Best known for a scenic terrace breakfast - good for the view and buffet, especially if you're staying nearby.
